scope: Official published IMD documentation and repository evidence only; no product API/data endpoint was probed.

decision.check_reason: The published materials reviewed do not explicitly authorize unauthenticated read-only endpoint probes and do not publish product API rate limits. B38 therefore does not call product/data endpoints.
decision.registration: The official API portal exposes Register/Create Account and Login. This suggests account registration is offered/expected for platform use, but per-product authentication requirements and whether any product is anonymously readable are UNKNOWN.
decision.source_owner: India Meteorological Department (IMD), Ministry of Earth Sciences; product-level operational owner/custodian and authorized project contact remain to be confirmed.
decision.provenance: Official API reference identifies product endpoints and sample schemas. No lawful product response was obtained, so no sample hash or response provenance is recorded.
human_follow_up: Project owner must request written API access instructions, account/authentication requirements, and explicit permission for read-only use by this project.
Obtain applicable terms, license, retention/redistribution conditions, fees, and published rate limits before any endpoint probe or integration.
Ask IMD/RMC Chennai for authoritative Chennai district, city, and station selector identifiers and mappings for each selected product.
Obtain a dated, authorized sample/schema with field types, units, timestamp semantics/timezone, publication/update timestamps, revisions, and missing/error behavior.
Measure update latency only after permission, using a documented observation window and timestamped method; do not treat nominal issue cadence as measured delivery latency.

official_sources.purpose: Published API catalogue, endpoint examples, and product field descriptions.
Official Data Access Portal; exposes Register/Create Account, Login, and Explore APIs.
States API use is subject to IMD terms and directs interested organizations to contact the IMD nodal officer; the actual terms are not reproduced.
Regional Meteorological Centre Chennai portal links district/station nowcast, rainfall products, AWS/daily observations, City Forecast, and identifies Chennai-Nungambakkam.
Published SOP says station and district nowcasts are issued at three-hour intervals; district warnings include start/end time in IST.
IMD reports operational district-level nowcasts for severe weather round-the-clock at three-hour intervals, updated every three hours on the IMD website.
Official Chennai-labelled city nowcast page; supports regional product availability, not API entitlement or API identifier mapping.
Official Location Specific Nowcast for Chennai page; its page parameter is not established as the API station identifier.

Date is observation date (YYYY-mm-dd). Forecasts are Day 1–Day 7; forecast issue/publication timestamp and exact within-day valid-time conventions are UNKNOWN.
